author: Michael Larabel
description: A long-in-development feature for AMD EPYC Zen 5 server platforms now merged for the Linux 7.0 kernel is ACPI PRMT-based address translation for the Compute Express Link (CXL) subsystem...
title: Linux 7.0 CXL Enables AMD Zen 5 Address Translation Feature

author: Michael Larabel
description: DRM Panic is the Linux kernel infrastructure now supported by most of the Direct Rendering Manager (DRM) kernel graphics/display drivers for being able to render a QR code kernel error message or similar when a kernel panic occurs to provide a cleaner interface should your system run into serious problems. An idea has been raised now within the Fedora Linux camp to provide an improved experience around this feature akin to Windows' "Blue Screen of Death" functionality...
title: Idea Raised For Nicer DRM Panic Screen Integration On Fedora Linux

author: Michael Larabel
description: For fans of Lutris as the open-source desktop client for installing and playing many games on Linux, Lutris 0.5.20 is out today with new features that further enhance the integration with different emulators and compatibility layers...
title: Lutris 0.5.20 Linux Game Manager Brings New Features, Wine Wayland Option

author: Michael Larabel
description: The RISC-V architecture updates have been merged for Linux 7.0 with a few items to note...
title: RISC-V In Linux 7.0 Brings User-Space CFI & Optimized strlen Assembly

author: Michael Larabel
description: Merged a few days ago for the Linux 7.0 kernel were all of the driver core enhancements. As has been the common theme in recent kernel releases, a lot of the driver core code churn revolves around additions for allowing more Rust kernel driver usage...
title: Linux 7.0 Driver Core Changes Bring More Enhancements For Rust Kernel Drivers

author: Michael Larabel
description: Linux 6.19.1 was released earlier today while it's since been replaced by Linux 6.19.2 to address fallout from that first point release with some systems not booting. This also resulted in new LTS kernel releases too due to the problematic code being picked up there too...
title: Linux 6.19.2 & Other LTS Kernels Released To Fix Systems Not Booting

author: Michael Larabel
description: The PCI subsystem updates for Linux 7.0 are aplenty as usual and contain a wide assortment of different fixes and code improvements...
title: Linux 7.0 Better Segregates Legacy CardBus Code To Avoid On Modern PCs

author: Michael Larabel
description: Upstreamed last week to the linux-firmware.git repository by Qualcomm was the GPU firmware files needed for enabling the Adreno GPU on the new Snapdragon X2 Elite laptop SoC...
title: Firmware Upstreamed For Supporting The Qualcomm Snapdragon X2's Adreno GPU

author: Michael Larabel
description: InputPlumber 0.74 is now available for this open-source input routing and control daemon for Linux systems. InputPlumber enables combining of multiple input devices, emulating different inputs, and a variety of other features particularly of benefit for Linux gaming...
title: InputPlumber 0.74 Released With Hardware Support Improvements

author: Michael Larabel
description: For those preferring to wait for the first point release of a new Linux kernel version before upgrading, Linux 6.19.1 is out today to address some early bugs that made it into the Linux 6.19 kernel stable release one week ago...
title: Linux 6.19.1 Released To Ship Some Early Fixes & Device Quirks
